design.name: Forest
design.description: Sage surfaces, deep evergreen actions and softly rounded, practical layouts.
design.guidance: Use clearly sage-tinted page backgrounds rather than white, evergreen primary actions and rounded utility panels. Keep headings sans-serif and the visual tone grounded. Use the bundled local fonts and product compositions. Separate page, panel and inset surfaces; keep metadata quiet but readable. Use the exported page/panel/row spacing and title scale consistently, with 44px action targets and brief 160ms interaction feedback. See docs/polish.md for the complete product contract.
